title: Snowflake Dendrite Crystallization Growth
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that simulates snowflake dendrite crystallization growth on a hexagonal lattice. The simulation models ice crystal formation with 6-fold symmetry.

## Scene Setup
- Dark navy/black background (0x0a0a1a).
- Orthographic camera looking down the Y-axis at the XZ plane. The camera should frame a region of roughly 20 units wide.
- Subtle ambient light (0x334466, intensity 0.3) and a directional light (0xaaccff, intensity 0.8) from above-right.
- A faint circular boundary ring (radius ~9 units) rendered as a wireframe torus or line loop on the XZ plane to show the growth domain.

## Hexagonal Lattice & Crystallization Model
- Use a hexagonal grid on the XZ plane. Each cell has a state: frozen (ice) or unfrozen (vapor). Store a diffusion field value (0.0 to 1.0) for each cell representing supersaturation.
- The grid should cover at least a 60x60 hex cell region centered at origin.
- Seed: a single frozen cell at the center.
- Each simulation step:
  1. Diffuse the vapor field: each unfrozen cell averages with its 6 hex neighbors (diffusion coefficient controlled by a parameter, default 0.5).
  2. Freeze rule: an unfrozen cell with at least one frozen neighbor freezes if its vapor value >= the freezing threshold (default 0.4).
  3. Boundary: cells at the edge maintain a constant vapor value equal to the 'boundary vapor' parameter (default 0.8).
- Enforce 6-fold symmetry: only compute 1/6th wedge and mirror results to the other 5 sectors.

## Rendering
- Render frozen cells as small hexagonal prisms (or flat cylinders) colored with a gradient from white at center to light blue (0x88ccff) at tips based on distance from origin.
- Unfrozen cells are invisible (or optionally shown as very faint dots if a toggle is on).
- Add a subtle glow/bloom effect on frozen cells using additive blending on a second pass or emissive material.

## User Interactions
- SPACE: Toggle play/pause of the simulation. Starts paused.
- RIGHT ARROW: Step forward one simulation tick (only when paused).
- R key: Reset simulation to initial seed state.
- UP/DOWN ARROW: Increase/decrease the freezing threshold by 0.05, clamped to [0.1, 0.9].
- Mouse wheel: Zoom the orthographic camera in/out (clamp between 5 and 40 units half-width).
- A DOM button labeled 'Toggle Vapor' that shows/hides the vapor field visualization (faint colored dots for unfrozen cells).
- A DOM button labeled 'Export Snapshot' that logs the current crystal stats to console and sets a snapshot flag.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left HUD overlay showing:
  - 'Step: {N}' — current simulation tick count
  - 'Frozen: {count}' — number of frozen cells
  - 'Threshold: {value}' — current freezing threshold (2 decimal places)
  - 'Status: Running/Paused'
  - 'Symmetry: 6-fold'
  - 'Branch Tips: {count}' — number of frozen cells at the frontier (frozen cells with < 6 frozen neighbors)
- Style the HUD with a semi-transparent dark background, white monospace text.

## State Management (CRITICAL)
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
  - simulationStep (integer): current tick count, starts at 0
  - frozenCount (integer): total frozen cells
  - branchTips (integer): frozen cells with fewer than 6 frozen neighbors
  - freezingThreshold (float): current threshold
  - isRunning (boolean): true if simulation is playing
  - vaporVisible (boolean): whether vapor field is shown
  - cameraZoom (float): current orthographic camera half-width
  - maxRadius (float): distance from origin to the farthest frozen cell
  - symmetryOrder (integer): always 6
  - snapshotTaken (boolean): set to true when Export Snapshot is clicked, reset to false on next step
  - cellsComputed (integer): total cells in the grid
  - boundaryVapor (float): the boundary vapor value (0.8)
  - diffusionCoeff (float): the diffusion coefficient (0.5)

## Physics / Conservation Constraints
- The frozen count must be monotonically non-decreasing (cells never unfreeze except on reset).
- maxRadius must be monotonically non-decreasing during growth.
- branchTips <= frozenCount always.
- The simulation must be deterministic: same threshold and steps from reset always produce the same frozenCount.
- 6-fold symmetry: frozenCount (excluding center seed) should be divisible by 6.
physics_constraints: Frozen cell count is monotonically non-decreasing. Max radius is monotonically non-decreasing. Branch tips never exceed frozen count. 6-fold symmetry enforced: frozen count minus 1 (seed) is divisible by 6. Diffusion field values stay in [0,1]. Freezing threshold clamped to [0.1, 0.9]. Deterministic growth from identical parameters.
